_approach: Kick pulled back to almost an afterthought (just beat 1 and a soft beat 4) while congaHigh/congaLow trade a call-and-response figure across both bars and claps carry the backbeat - the more percussive, jam-session-like corner of 3-step where 'more than one person in the room' (Beatportal) is audible in the interlocking parts. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
